cards.meaning: was blocked or intercepted (physically, in one's path)
cards.example: Hinarang ng mga barko ng China Coast Guard ang pangkat ng Philippine Coast Guard malapit sa Pag-asa.
cards.exampleMeaning: China Coast Guard ships blocked the Philippine Coast Guard team near Pag-asa.
cards.note: Pangkaraniwan sa balita; tumutukoy sa aktuwal na paghadlang sa daan. Mas payak kaysa 'hinadlangan', na mas malawak ang kahulugan.
cards.tiesTo: CCG blocking a PCG team near Pag-asa Island

cards.meaning: delay (the state of being held up)
cards.example: Ang pagkaantala ng testimonya ng AMLC ay nagbigay ng dagdag na oras sa depensa.
cards.exampleMeaning: The delay in the AMLC testimony gave the defense extra time.
cards.note: Ang 'ipagpaliban' ay sadyang pagpapaliban; ang 'pagkaantala' ay ang mismong pagkahuli, madalas hindi sinasadya.
cards.tiesTo: Deferred AMLC testimony at the impeachment trial

cards.meaning: would rather … than … (accepting a cost to avoid something worse)
cards.example: 消费者宁可存钱，也不愿多花钱。
cards.examplePinyin: Xiāofèizhě nìngkě cún qián, yě bù yuàn duō huā qián.
cards.exampleMeaning: Consumers would rather save than spend more.
cards.note: Neutral-to-书面语 connective. Contrast 与其…不如: 与其 disparages option A and favors B; 宁可 accepts a real cost to avoid worse.
cards.tiesTo: Golden Week: more trips, thin per-trip spending

cards.example: 人均花费下降反映出消费者的谨慎。
cards.examplePinyin: Rénjūn huāfèi xiàjiàng fǎnyìng chū xiāofèizhě de jǐnshèn.
cards.exampleMeaning: The drop in per-person spending reflects consumer caution.
cards.note: 书面语/news register: 反映出信心/问题/趋势. Contrast 表明 (firmer, evidence-driven 'demonstrates'): 反映 is a softer 'mirrors'.
cards.tiesTo: Per-trip spend of 911 yuan during Golden Week
